actions.label: Model tree

plate.description: Only the objects on this plate (0-based); -1 = every plate.

actions.summary: Every object on the plates with its stable id, instances (position, rotation, scale), parts (type, filament, paint), per-object setting overrides, layer ranges and cut planes.

actions.label: Select

mode.description: target: the target objects, parts or instances; plate: all on a plate; all: all plates; none: deselect.

plate.description: mode plate: which plate (0-based); -1 = the current one.

actions.summary: Select exactly the target objects, parts (target.volumes) or instances (target.instances), every object on a plate, every object on every plate, or nothing.

actions.label: Rename
actions.summary: Rename an object (a single-part object's part takes the same name).

actions.label: Delete

breakCutLink.description: Required true to delete a piece of a cut object, which breaks the link between the pieces.

actions.summary: Delete objects from the plate (undoable).

actions.label: Rename part
actions.summary: Rename one part (solid part, modifier, negative part, support blocker/enforcer) of an object, as editing its name in the object list does. Text and SVG parts take their name from the text or file again when edited.

actions.label: Delete part

breakCutLink.description: Required true to delete a solid part or negative part of a cut object, which breaks the link between the cut pieces.

actions.summary: Delete parts, modifiers, negative parts or support blockers/enforcers from their objects (undoable). The last solid part of an object cannot be deleted; a part left alone takes over its object's settings.

actions.label: Clone
actions.summary: Add copies of objects as new, independent objects; optionally arrange the plate afterwards.

actions.label: Add instance
actions.summary: Add instances (linked copies sharing the object's mesh and settings) to an object, as the + button does.

actions.label: Remove instance

count.description: With an object target: how many of its last instances to remove.

actions.summary: Remove instances: the last ones of one object (count, as the - button does), or exactly the instances named in target.instances (Del on instance rows). An object always keeps one.

actions.label: Set as individual objects

instances.description: Instance indices to separate; omitted = every instance.

actions.summary: Turn an object's instances (all, or the listed ones) into separate objects that can then be edited independently.

actions.label: Center
actions.summary: Move objects to the centre of their plate (XY); also one part within its object (target.volumes) or single instances (target.instances).

actions.label: Drop
actions.summary: Drop objects straight down onto the bed; also one part (target.volumes) or single instances (target.instances).

actions.label: Auto Drop
actions.summary: Turn Auto Drop on or off for objects: when on, an object always rests on the bed after edits.

actions.label: Printable
actions.summary: Mark objects (every instance) or single instances (target.instances) printable or not; non-printable ones stay on the plate but are not sliced.

actions.label: Hide / Show
actions.summary: Hide or show objects in the assembly view (display only; nothing about the print changes).

actions.label: Mirror
actions.summary: Mirror objects along a plate axis; also one part within its object (target.volumes) or single instances (target.instances). An object with several instances mirrors only by instance.

actions.label: Order

before.description: Objects only: the object (on the same plate) to move in front of; {id}, {index} or {name}.

move.description: One step or to an end.

toIndex.description: Objects: 0-based place among the objects on its plate. Parts: the part index to take (parts stay among parts of their type; index 0 is kept for a solid part).

actions.summary: Move one object within its plate's list order, or one part (target.volumes) among its object's parts: first, up, down, last, to a position, or in front of another object. Objects print in list order when printing by object.

actions.label: Split to objects

keepZ.description: Keep each piece's height (turns Auto Drop off for them); false drops every piece onto the bed. Default: keep when the object was not auto-dropping.

actions.summary: Split an object made of several disconnected pieces into one object per piece.

actions.label: Assemble

mode.description: multipart: objects become parts of one new object; single: one object's parts fuse into one part.

actions.summary: Assemble several objects into one multi-part object (multipart), or merge one object's parts into a single part (single).

actions.label: Convert units
actions.summary: Rescale objects that were modelled in inches or metres (x25.4 / x1000), or undo that conversion.

actions.label: Reload from disk
actions.summary: Reload objects' meshes from the files they were loaded from.

actions.label: Copy process settings
actions.summary: Copy an object's own process settings (its per-object overrides) for object.pasteSettings.

actions.label: Paste process settings
actions.summary: Replace objects' own process settings with the ones copied by object.copySettings.

actions.label: Move / rotate / scale

frame.description: relative: offset, rotation and scale all along the plate's axes (world) or all along the object's own (object), about its centre, as the gizmos' coordinate combo. Absent: offset and rotation along the plate's, scale along the object's own.

offset.description: Instance position [x, y, z] in mm, plate frame (relative: added).

relative.description: Change by these amounts instead of setting them.

rotationDeg.description: Rotation [x, y, z] in degrees (absolute: Euler XYZ; relative: about the plate's X, then Y, then Z, around the object's centre).

actions.summary: Set an object's position (instance offset, mm), rotation (degrees, XYZ Euler) and scale (factor per axis, may differ per axis) -- absolute, or relative to the current values.

actions.label: Lay on face

largestFace.description: true: the largest flat face (of the convex hull).

normal.description: World direction [x, y, z] the face currently points to (e.g. [1,0,0] = the side facing +X).

actions.summary: Turn an object so a flat face lies on the bed: the face pointing along a direction, or its largest flat face.

actions.label: Delete all
actions.summary: Delete every object on a plate (default: the current one) or on every plate (undoable).

actions.label: Cut
actions.summary: Cut objects to the slicer's clipboard (they leave the plate until pasted).

actions.label: Copy
actions.summary: Copy objects, or parts (target.volumes), to the slicer's clipboard.

actions.label: Paste
actions.summary: Paste what the slicer's clipboard holds: copied objects onto the plate, copied parts into the object named in the target. Reports the objects and parts added.

actions.label: Delete all connectors
actions.summary: Delete every connector (plug or dowel) of a cut, on all of its pieces, keeping the cut link; a piece left with no solid part is deleted too (reported in removedObjects). Undoable.

actions.label: Add part

name.description: Name shown in the object list.

positionMm.description: Center of the part on the plate, in mm [x,y,z] (plate frame, Z up from the bed).

relativeTo.description: positionMm is in plate coordinates, or an offset from the center of the object's bounding box.

rotationDeg.description: Rotation in degrees about the plate X, Y and Z axes, applied in that order.

shape.description: A primitive, or "url" to load a model file (STL/OBJ/3MF/AMF) from params.url.

sizeMm.description: Size in mm: one value = the largest dimension (uniform), three = the bounding box [x,y,z]. Default: a tenth of the bed's largest side, as the menu does.

type.description: What the new volume is: a solid part, a negative part (subtracted), a settings modifier, a support blocker/enforcer, or an infill mesh.

url.description: http(s) URL of the model file when shape is "url"; the tab's download rules apply.

actions.summary: Add a part, negative part, modifier, support blocker/enforcer or infill mesh to an object: a primitive shape (cube, cylinder, sphere, cone, disc, torus) or a model file from a URL, with size, position and rotation.

actions.label: Change type
actions.summary: Change what parts are: solid part, negative part, modifier, support blocker, support enforcer or infill mesh.

actions.label: Change filament
actions.summary: Assign parts or modifiers to a filament slot (1-based); 0 makes a part use its object's filament.

actions.label: Move / rotate / scale part

frame.description: relative: along the plate's axes (world) or the part's own (object), as the gizmos' coordinate combo.

positionMm.description: Where the part's origin (its center when added) goes on the plate, mm (relative: how far to move it).

relative.description: Change by these amounts, about the part's centre, instead of setting them.

rotationDeg.description: Rotation in degrees about the plate X, Y and Z axes, applied in that order.

scale.description: Scale factors along the part's X, Y, Z (1 = original size; relative: multiplied).

actions.summary: Place one part of an object: its position on the plate, rotation about the plate axes and scale (per axis); anything left out keeps its current value. Or, relative, move / turn / scale it by amounts along the plate's axes or its own (frame).

actions.label: Split to parts
actions.summary: Split a part made of several disconnected pieces into one part per piece, inside the same object.

actions.label: Mesh boolean
actions.summary: Merge every part of an object into one solid part (negative parts are subtracted, modifiers dropped); the object is replaced by the merged one.

actions.label: Replace 3D file

url.description: http(s) URL of the model file; the tab's download rules apply.

actions.summary: Replace one part's mesh with a model file from a URL (STL/OBJ/3MF/AMF holding one part); the part keeps its place, type, settings and paint.

actions.label: Add Primitive

positionMm.description: Where on the plate, mm; only x and y are used, the object sits on the bed.

sizeMm.description: Size in mm: one value = the largest dimension (uniform), three = the bounding box [x,y,z]. Default: a tenth of the bed's largest side, as the menu does.

actions.summary: Add a new object that is a primitive shape (cube, cylinder, sphere, cone, disc, torus) to the plate.

actions.summary: Add one of the bundled test models (3DBenchy, calibration cubes, Stanford bunny, tolerance and stringing tests) to the plate.

actions.label: Mesh boolean

keepTool.description: Keep the second part after a difference or intersection, as the tool does unless "Delete input" is ticked (a union always consumes it).

actions.summary: Combine two parts of one object into one: union, difference (the second part cut out of the first) or intersection. The first part is replaced by the result; the second stays unless keepTool is false (a union consumes it).

actions.label: Simplify Model

detail.description: The tool's Detail level: the quadric error allowed (1e-3, 1e-2, 0.1, 0.5, 1); the count follows.

maxError.description: The quadric error allowed, as detail but any value.

ratio.description: Fraction of the triangles to KEEP. The Simplify tool's "Decimate ratio" is the percent REMOVED: its 30% is ratio 0.7.

actions.summary: Reduce the triangle count of parts (or of every part of an object): to a fraction of the current count, to a target count, or to a detail level (how far the surface may move). Runs in the background.

actions.label: Subdivision mesh

allowLarge.description: Go ahead past one million faces.

actions.summary: Subdivide and smooth parts (each pass makes four triangles of one). Refuses past a million faces unless allowLarge. Runs in the background.

actions.label: Fix Model
actions.summary: Repair parts whose meshes are not closed (open edges, holes) so they slice cleanly. Parts without errors are left alone. Runs in the background.

actions.label: Cut

params.description: Per piece, placeOnCut and flip exclude each other (as in the tool); neither applies with keepAsParts.

assign.description: Cut by contour: after cutting, the object's disconnected pieces each go with the side of the plane they lie on; each entry moves the piece nearest pointMm to `side` (the tool's right-click).

pointMm.description: A point on or near the piece, plate coordinates.

connectors.description: Plugs, dowels or snaps joining the two pieces (then both pieces are kept, as separate objects).

bulgePct.description: Snap: bulge, % of the radius; at most spacePct.

positionMm.description: Where on the cut face, plate coordinates (projected onto the plane); default: where the plane crosses the object's center.

rotationDeg.description: Turn the connector about the plane normal (from the plane's X axis).

spacePct.description: Snap: slit space, % of the radius.

flipLower.description: Turn the lower piece upside down.

flipUpper.description: Turn the upper piece over so its cut face is on the bed.

groove.description: Dovetail groove; defaults as the tool picks them from the object's size.

instance.description: Which instance's position the plane refers to.

keepAsParts.description: Keep both pieces as parts of one object.

mode.description: dovetail: a tongue-and-groove joint along the plane (no connectors, no keepAsParts).

placeOnCut.description: Lay both pieces on their cut faces.

placeOnCutLower.description: Lay the lower piece on its cut face.

placeOnCutUpper.description: Lay the upper piece on its cut face.

normal.description: The plane's normal; the "upper" piece is on its side.

point.description: A point on the plane, plate coordinates in mm.

spinDeg.description: Turn the plane about its normal (the tool's rotation grabbers): orients a dovetail groove and square, hexagon or triangle connectors. The reply gives the resulting planeXAxis.

z.description: Height of a horizontal cut above the bed, mm.

actions.summary: Cut an object with a plane: at a height (z) or through any point with any normal, flat (planar) or with a dovetail groove. Keep both pieces (as two objects, or as parts of one), or only the upper / lower one; place each piece on its cut face or flip it; join them with plug, dowel or snap connectors; or move disconnected parts to the other side (assign, the tool's cut by contour).

actions.label: Cut along pipe

bedRoot.description: Where the root stands on the bed.

boreAspectMin.description: traceBores threshold: bore depth / width needed.

collapseToSpine.description: Collapse side branches onto the main spine.

cutAt.description: Add only the plane of this edge in the cut order (0 = first; preview lists them): the tool's Step + Cut here.

faceBudget.description: Decimate denser meshes to this many faces first (0 = off). Faster, but can change the skeleton of organic parts; raise it when a build would not finish in time.

method.description: mcf = mean-curvature flow (default, smoother), voxel = voxel thinning (faster on dense meshes).

minEdgeFactor.description: mcf: minimum edge length, fraction of the bounding-box diagonal.

preview.description: Only report the planes (world frame, with each one's tilt), changing nothing.

pruneLeavesMm.description: Remove branch tips shorter than this, mm (0 = off).

replace.description: Replace the object's cut planes instead of adding to them.

resampleEdgeLenMm.description: Target edge length after resampling, mm (the segment height); 0 = off.

rootLeanDeg.description: How far the cuts beside a middle root may lean toward flat.

rootRampMm.description: Distance over which that hold releases, mm (0 = auto).

tangentBlend.description: Blend of the cut normals toward the local tangent.

traceBores.description: Trace the centreline of bores (pipes): never, when deep relative to their width, or always.

voxelResolution.description: voxel: grid resolution; cost is cubic in it.

actions.summary: Find an object's centreline (its skeleton) and add one cut plane per skeleton edge, so a bent tube or limb prints in segments along its length; or add only one edge's plane (cutAt), or list the planes without adding them (preview). Takes the Skeleton tool's generator settings. Runs in the background; can take minutes (object.cancelSkeleton stops it).

actions.label: Cancel

jobId.description: The jobId object.skeletonCutPlanes answered with "running"; default: all of this tab's.

actions.summary: Stop this tab's running object.skeletonCutPlanes build (or the one jobId names); it ends when its current stage does and changes nothing.

actions.label: Invalidate cut info
actions.summary: Forget that an object came from a cut, so its pieces can be edited (scaled, split) independently.

actions.label: Add text

bold.description: The face's bold variant, or synthetic boldness when it has none (as the tool).

boldness.description: Synthetic boldness, font units (the tool's slider spans about +-half the letter ascent; bold on a face without a bold variant uses 20; 0 = none).

charGap.description: Extra space between letters, font units (0 = none).

depthMm.description: How far it stands out or cuts in, mm.

font.description: Installed font face name (text.listFonts); default: the Text tool's.

fontIndex.description: Which face of a font collection file (.ttc), 0-based (the tool's Collection).

italic.description: The face's italic variant, or a skew when it has none (as the tool).

lineGap.description: Extra space between lines, font units (0 = none).

offsetMm.description: Shift from the side's center [along, up] in mm.

side.description: Which side of the object it goes on (front faces -Y, the user).

skew.description: Italic strength, a ratio (the tool's slider spans -1..1; italic on a face without an italic variant uses 0.2; 0 = none).

text.description: The text; \n starts a new line.

type.description: part = raised, negative = engraved into the surface, modifier = a settings region.

actions.summary: Emboss (raise) or engrave text on a side of an object, with font, height and depth. The text stays editable (text.edit, or the Text tool).

actions.label: Edit text

boldness.description: Synthetic boldness, font units (the tool's slider spans about +-half the letter ascent; bold on a face without a bold variant uses 20; 0 = none).

charGap.description: Extra space between letters, font units (0 = none).

actions.summary: Move a plate (default: the current one) to another place in the plate order, e.g. 0 to put it first (the plate's Move-to-front icon); the plates in between shift by one. Returns the new order.

actions.label: Reload All

actions.label: Auto orient

actions.summary: Move objects or single instances (copies) to another plate, or to a new plate; optionally arrange it.

remove.description: z values (mm) of events to delete.

timeMode.description: Time estimate: normal, or stealth (silent) mode when the printer profile has one.

actions.summary: A sliced plate's figures, as the preview legend shows them: total time, filament per slot (mm3, m, g, cost), per feature time/filament/share, travel, retract/unretract/wipe/seam figures, filament-change time, colour-scale ranges, per-layer times on request; or the All Plates Stats totals.

beltRaw.description: Belt printer G-code: true shows the raw machine-frame G-code, false the upright view.

viewType.description: section only when the print has more than one section.

actions.summary: Switch between Prepare and Preview and set what the preview shows, as its legend and sliders do: colouring, layers (or one layer), the move on the moves slider, which features, travel/wipe/retract/seam markers and sections are visible, normal/stealth times, a belt printer's raw G-code. cascade.description: A created printer: also delete the filament and process presets made for it.

type.description: Which settings tab: printer, print (process) or filament.

actions.summary: Delete one of the person's own presets and its file, after a native confirmation. A printer the person created takes its filament and process presets with it: that needs cascade:true, and the confirmation lists them. Presets synced to a cloud account are refused.

actions.label: Compare presets

a.description: First side, an installed preset as saved. Default: the tab's preset with unsaved edits.

against.description: Without b: saved = the preset as saved (lists unsaved edits); parent = the preset it is based on; edited = the tab's preset with its unsaved edits (what a named a is compared with when against is saved).

b.description: Second side, an installed preset. Overrides against.

type.description: Which settings tab: printer, print (process) or filament.

actions.summary: List the settings that differ between the tab's preset (with its unsaved edits) and its saved state or the preset it is based on, or between two named presets.

actions.label: Revert settings

keys.description: Setting keys; "key#i" for one value of a per-extruder or per-variant setting.

type.description: Which settings tab: printer, print (process) or filament.

actions.summary: Put settings of the tab's preset back to their saved values, or to the preset it is based on (the tab's undo arrows). "key#i" reverts one extruder or variant value; custom G-code and compatibility lists can be reverted too. An unsaved edit, undone with undoTurn.

actions.label: Discard changes

type.description: Which settings tab: printer, print (process) or filament.

actions.summary: Drop every unsaved edit of the tab's preset. Asks natively unless every edit was made by this same turn.

actions.label: Show or hide preset

name.description: The system preset, by name or display name.

type.description: Which settings tab: printer, print (process) or filament.

actions.summary: Show or hide an installed system preset in the preset lists (the setup wizard's printer and filament ticks). Process presets have no tick of their own: their visibility lasts for this session only.

actions.label: Create preset

base.description: The template preset, by name or display name; hidden system presets allowed.

slot.description: Filament: the slot that takes the new preset.

type.description: Which settings tab: printer, print (process) or filament.

values.description: Setting key -> value, as slicer.setSettings takes them. Keys are checked by the slicer.

actions.summary: Create a user preset from an installed or hidden system template with some values changed, save it under a name and select it; a filament goes into one slot only.

actions.confirmSkipRule: the native Save dialog is the consent: the person picks the file
actions.label: Export presets

format.description: zip: plain archive of preset files; bundle: an .orca_bundle that imports as one named bundle.

type.description: Which settings tab: printer, print (process) or filament.

actions.summary: Write some of the person's own presets into a .zip, or an .orca_bundle with a name, author, version and description, saved where they choose in the native Save dialog. Print-host addresses, credentials and local bed-model paths are left out.

actions.label: Import preset bundle

installVendors.description: Install the shipped printer profiles the presets are based on when they are missing (listed in the confirmation; reloads every preset, so ifDirty applies).

overwrite.description: Replace user presets of the same name.

url.description: http(s) URL on the page's host or the tab's download hosts.

actions.summary: Download a preset bundle (.zip, .orca_bundle, .orca_printer, .orca_filament) and import its presets after a native confirmation. Print hosts, credentials and post-processing scripts are removed; custom G-code is listed in the confirmation.

actions.label: Import configs

installVendors.description: Install the shipped printer profiles the presets are based on when they are missing (listed in the confirmation; reloads every preset, so ifDirty applies).

overwrite.description: Replace user presets of the same name.

url.description: http(s) URL on the page's host or the tab's download hosts.

actions.summary: Download a preset file (.json, or any bundle form) and import it after a native confirmation. Print hosts, credentials and post-processing scripts are removed; custom G-code is listed in the confirmation.

actions.label: Set compatible printers

name.description: The preset to edit (default: the tab's).

printers.description: Printer presets it suits; [] = all printers.

prints.description: Filament only: process presets it suits; [] = all.

actions.summary: Set which printers (and, for a filament, which processes) the tab's process or filament preset suits: the Profile dependencies lists. An empty list means all. An unsaved edit; name switches the tab to that preset first (under ifDirty).

actions.label: Transfer settings

from.description: The preset the values come from (left side).

to.description: The preset that takes them (right side).

type.description: Which settings tab: printer, print (process) or filament.

actions.summary: Copy settings from one preset into another as unsaved edits (the compare dialog's Transfer): the tab switches to `to` (under ifDirty) and takes `keys` from `from` as saved. "key#i" moves one extruder value.

actions.label: Copy to other extruder

type.description: Which settings tab: printer, print (process) or filament.

actions.summary: Copy one extruder's per-extruder values over another's in the tab's preset, as unsaved edits (the tab's copy button). Without keys, the edited ones.

actions.label: Set extruder count
actions.summary: Set how many extruders the printer preset has (the printer tab's Extruders field), resizing per-extruder settings and filament slots. An unsaved edit. Not for printers whose extruders are fixed by the machine.

actions.label: Set bed shape

modelUrl.description: http(s) URL on the page's host or the tab's download hosts.

shape.description: Default: from sizeMm (rectangle), diameterMm (circle) or points (custom).

textureUrl.description: http(s) URL on the page's host or the tab's download hosts.

actions.summary: Set the printer preset's bed (the printer tab's bed shape dialog): a rectangle (size and origin), a circle (diameter) or a polygon, its height, and a custom bed texture or model downloaded from a URL. Unsaved edits of the printer preset.

actions.label: Set file setting from URL

url.description: http(s) URL on the page's host or the tab's download hosts.

actions.summary: Point a print setting that names a file (infill SVG pattern, infill mesh) at a file downloaded from a URL (the print tab's Browse buttons). An unsaved edit of the process preset.

actions.label: List preset bundles
actions.summary: The preset bundles the slicer holds (imported, default): id, name, type, author, version and the presets in each.

actions.label: Delete preset bundle
actions.summary: Delete an imported preset bundle and every preset loaded from it, after a native confirmation. None of its presets may be selected.

actions.label: Create filament

base.description: The filament it starts from, by name or display name; hidden system presets allowed.

actions.summary: Create a user filament "<vendor> <type> <serial>" for one or more printers (the Create Filament dialog): each copy starts from the base filament's preset for that printer, is limited to it and shares one new filament id.

actions.label: Create printer

printer.description: The template printer preset; hidden system presets allowed.

scaleToNozzle.description: Set the copied processes' layer heights, line widths and shells for the nozzle.

actions.summary: Create a printer preset from a template printer (the Create Printer dialog): a new vendor and model with its bed, or another nozzle of the template's model; with copies of the chosen process and filament presets limited to it. It is selected, as the dialog does, so unsaved edits are under ifDirty (save or discard).

actions.label: List physical printers
actions.summary: The physical printers (print hosts) set up in the slicer: names and the printer presets they use. No addresses or credentials.

actions.confirmSkipRule: the ifProjectDirty protocol: an unsaved project is only replaced on save, discard or the slicer's own prompt
actions.label: New Project
actions.summary: Close the current project and start an empty one. Honours ifProjectDirty: an unsaved project is never dropped without ifProjectDirty save, discard or prompt.

actions.label: Save Project
actions.summary: Save the project to its own file after a native confirmation, or, never saved, where the person picks in the native Save dialog.

actions.confirmSkipRule: the native Save dialog is the consent: the person picks the file
actions.label: Save Project as
actions.summary: Save the project to a new file the person picks in the native Save dialog; it becomes the project's file.

actions.label: Project info
actions.summary: The open project's name, file name, unsaved state, object and plate counts, and the recent projects by name.

actions.confirmSkipRule: the ifProjectDirty and ifDirty protocols: unsaved work is only replaced on save, discard or the slicer's own prompt
actions.label: Open recent project
actions.summary: Open one of the recent projects by its index in project.info. Honours ifProjectDirty and ifDirty.

actions.label: Import model

url.description: http(s) URL on the page's host or the tab's download hosts.

actions.summary: Download a model (3MF/STL/STEP/OBJ/AMF/SVG/DRC) or a ZIP archive of models and add it to the plate, as Import does. Geometry only; to open a project file with its settings use slicer.openProjectFromUrl.

actions.label: Back to the project
actions.summary: Close the G-code preview that replaced the project (a G-code handed over by a web app) and bring the project back as it was: same file, name and unsaved state. As the preview notification's link or a click on Prepare. 1008 when no project is set aside. Honours ifDirty for unsaved preset edits.

actions.label: Project info
actions.summary: Set the project's Basic Info (saved in the 3MF): author, model name, license, description. Each is optional; the project becomes unsaved. project.info reads them.

actions.label: Project files
actions.summary: The project's auxiliary files by folder (pictures, bom, assembly, others), with sizes and which picture is the cover.

actions.label: Add file

name.description: File name to store it under.

url.description: http(s) URL on the page's host or the tab's download hosts.

actions.summary: Download a file into one of the project's auxiliary folders, as the Project tab's Add File does: pictures (png/jpg/jpeg/bmp), bom (xls/xlsx/pdf), assembly (pdf), others (txt). A taken name gets a _2, _3 ... suffix.

actions.label: Set as cover
actions.summary: Make one of the project's pictures its cover (the 3MF's cover and thumbnails), as Set as cover does.

actions.label: Delete file
actions.summary: Delete one of the project's auxiliary files after a native confirmation (not undoable); a cover picture stops being the cover.

actions.label: Remove from recent

index.description: Without it the whole list is cleared.

actions.summary: Remove one project from the recent list by its index in project.info, or (no index) clear the list, as Home does. No file is deleted.

actions.confirmSkipRule: the native Save dialog is the consent: the person picks the file
actions.label: Export

fileName.description: Suggested file name (per-object kinds: the first file's).

actions.summary: Export to a file the person picks in the native Save dialog: stl/drc (objects merged into one mesh), stls/drcs (one file per object), 3mf (generic 3MF), publish3mf, toolpathsObj (the sliced preview's toolpaths). Targets limit a mesh export to those objects.

actions.label: Reload G-code
actions.summary: Reload the G-code file shown in the G-code preview from disk.

actions.label: Remove filament

replaceWith.description: 0-based slot that takes over its objects and painting; absent = each object's default.

actions.summary: Remove a filament slot from the project; objects printing with it move to replaceWith (or their default). The person confirms in a slicer dialog.

actions.label: Remove filaments

keep.description: 0-based slots to keep; every other slot is removed.

replaceWith.description: 0-based slot (one that stays) that takes over their objects and painting; absent = each object's default.

slots.description: 0-based slots to remove (physical or mixed), each once.

actions.summary: Remove several filament slots at once (slots, or keep = every other slot goes); the person confirms ONE slicer dialog for all of them. Use instead of repeating filament.delete.

actions.label: Merge with
actions.summary: Merge one filament slot into another: the first is removed and everything printed with it prints with the second. The person confirms in a slicer dialog.

actions.label: Change filament colour
actions.summary: Set the display colour of a physical filament slot (what the plate, the preview and flushing volumes use).

actions.label: Flushing volumes
actions.summary: Read the flushing-volume matrix (mm3 purged going from the row slot to the column slot) and the multiplier, per nozzle.

actions.label: Flushing volumes

matrix.description: Rows and columns in physical slot order; the diagonal is ignored.

actions.summary: Set the flushing volumes: "auto" recalculates them from the colours (the dialog's auto-calculation); "matrix" writes a p x p matrix over the physical slots (row = from, column = to, mm3).

actions.label: Purge mode
actions.summary: Choose the purge mode on printers that offer one: default, saving (multi-nozzle extruders) or fast.

actions.label: Add mixed filament

gradient.description: Blend from the first to the second component over the height.

gradientPerPart.description: Run the gradient over each part's own height.

gradientReverse.description: Blend from the second to the first instead.

ratios.description: Relative share of each component in percent; absent = equal shares.

actions.summary: Add a mixed (virtual) filament that alternates two or more physical filaments by layer share, optionally as a two-filament gradient over the height.

actions.label: Edit mixed filament

gradient.description: Blend from the first to the second component over the height (two components only).

gradientPerPart.description: Run the gradient over each part's own height.

gradientReverse.description: Blend from the second to the first instead.

ratios.description: Relative share of each component in percent; absent with new components = equal shares.

actions.summary: Change a mixed filament in place (components, layer shares, gradient): it keeps its slot, so everything printing with it still does. Anything not given stays as it is.

actions.label: Decompose Color

colour.description: Hex colour to match instead of the slot's.

dryRun.description: Report the recommended mix without changing anything.

materialType.description: The dialog's material: a type of the project's filaments, or "PLA Basic"; absent = the slot's type.

mode.description: Which recommendation; absent = the first the dialog offers for the material.

slot.description: 0-based physical slot whose colour to decompose (it is left out of the mix).

actions.summary: Turn a colour (a filament slot's, or one given) into a mixed filament of printable filaments, as Decompose Color does: from the project's filaments (materialList) or standard CMYW/RYBW PLA Basic colours. Standard colours the project lacks are added as new slots after the person agrees in a slicer dialog. dryRun only reports the mix.

actions.label: Nozzle
actions.summary: Switch to this printer's preset for another nozzle diameter, as the sidebar's nozzle box does (honours ifDirty).

actions.label: Plate type
actions.summary: Set the project's build plate type (the sidebar's plate box); plates given their own type keep it.

actions.confirmSkipRule: no dialog when the plate is empty (nothing is replaced), or when ifProjectDirty "prompt" lets the slicer ask its own save question about a dirty project; unsaved projects and preset edits additionally need ifProjectDirty / ifDirty (decision D13)
actions.label: Calibration

autoAdjust.description: vfa: when the end speed exceeds the filament's max volumetric speed, lower the layer height to a standard one that reaches it (resizing only), else also lower the end speed. The result's used.vfaAdjust says what happened.

damping.description: inputShapingFrequency: damping factor used while sweeping the frequency.

extruderType.description: pressureAdvance: picks the default range (bowden goes to 1.0).

flowMethod.description: flowRatio: the linear (YOLO) test or the classic two-pass test.

freqStartY.description: inputShapingFrequency: Y start frequency (Hz); RepRapFirmware uses X.

method.description: pressureAdvance: tower, line or pattern test.

nozzleBasedResize.description: temperature, vfa: scale the model to the nozzle diameter.

pass.description: flowRatio: pass 1, or pass 2 (the finer test / the perfectionist version).

printNumbers.description: pressureAdvance line: print the value beside each line.

shaperType.description: Input shaping: shaper type the printer's firmware offers (default: the first).

start.description: Start of the tested range (pressure advance, degC, mm3/s, mm/s, mm, damping or cornering).

step.description: Step between test blocks (pressureAdvance, maxFlowrate, vfa, retraction).

testModel.description: inputShaping*: 0 ringing tower, 1 fast tower. cornering: the dialog's model choice.

actions.summary: Build a calibration test as a new project, as the Calibration menu does: pressure advance, temperature, max flowrate, flow ratio, retraction, cornering, input shaping frequency/damping or VFA. Replaces the project (honours ifProjectDirty and ifDirty); then slice and print it. Temperatures snap down to multiples of 5 degC, as the dialog's fields do.

actions.label: Camera view
actions.summary: Point the 3D view's camera: default (the whole plate), iso, topFront (the current plate from the top front, as Ctrl+7), top, bottom, front, rear, left or right.

actions.label: Camera projection
actions.summary: Use a perspective or orthogonal camera, and switch automatic perspective (orthographic for top/side views) on or off.

actions.label: Show in 3D view
actions.summary: Show or hide a 3D view overlay: G-code window, 3D navigator, gridlines, bed mesh height map, cut chunk colours, object labels, overhang highlight or selected outline. Without on, it flips.

actions.label: Zoom to
actions.summary: Fit the 3D view to the bed, a plate, all objects, the selection or the sliced toolpaths.

actions.label: Assembly view
actions.summary: Switch the Prepare tab between the assembly view (parts exploded around the object) and the normal 3D view.

actions.label: Preview Mesh Infill
actions.summary: Generate the mesh-backed infill of an object as a non-printing preview volume that follows it (run again after changes to refresh; an up-to-date preview is left as is). Refused when the object's infill cannot be previewed.

actions.label: Show tab

url.description: tab=universe: a page on the Universe site's own origin to open there.

actions.summary: Show a main tab (home, prepare, preview, device, project, calibration, universe) or the print, filament (of a slot) or printer settings. The universe tab can open a page of its own site.

actions.label: Show setting
actions.summary: Open the settings page holding a setting and highlight it, so the person can see or type it (e.g. print host keys).

actions.label: Close tool
actions.summary: Close the open 3D-view tool (gizmo) so other edits can run; its unapplied changes are lost. The person confirms in a slicer dialog.

actions.label: Collapse sidebar
actions.summary: Collapse or expand the Prepare tab's settings sidebar.

actions.label: Reset Window Layout
actions.summary: Put the window's panels back to the default layout.

actions.confirmSkipRule: only reads the mesh the printer already has loaded from the printer host of the selected preset; nothing is sent that moves or changes the printer, and the printer permission (off by default) gates it
actions.label: Reload Bed Mesh from Printer

show.description: Also switch the bed mesh overlay on.

actions.summary: Read the bed mesh the printer has loaded (Moonraker, OctoPrint or Duet host) and show it as a height map on the plate. Finishes when the mesh arrived (its summary; loaded false when the printer has none) or the read failed.

actions.label: Bed mesh
actions.summary: The bed mesh last read from the printer (printer.fetchBedMesh or View > Show Bed Mesh): host, profile, grid corners, probe grid and flatness in mm. Talks to nothing; loaded is false when no mesh was read.

actions.label: Preferences

names.description: Which preferences to read; absent = all of them.

actions.summary: Read the preferences that can be changed automatically (units, appearance, camera and mouse, behaviour), with their allowed values.

actions.label: Preferences

values.description: Preferences to change, by name; only these names exist.

autoArrangeAfterClone.description: Auto arrange plate after cloning: Arrange the plate after cloning objects.

autoBackup.description: Auto backup: Back up the open project periodically, for crash recovery.

autoBackupSeconds.description: Auto backup: Seconds between automatic project backups.

autoFlush.description: Auto flush after changing: Recalculate flushing volumes when filaments or their colours change.

autoSlice.description: Auto slice after changes: Re-slice automatically after slicing-related changes.

autoSliceDelaySeconds.description: Auto slice after changes: Seconds to wait after a change before auto slicing, so several edits slice once.

cameraStyle.description: Camera style: Default: left drag rotates, right/middle drag pans. Touchpad: Alt+move rotates, Shift+move pans.

colorScheme.description: Colour scheme: Follow the system's light or dark appearance, or force one.

colourVision.description: Colour vision: Palettes of the G-code preview and the bed mesh map for colour-vision deficiencies.

defaultPage.description: Default page: The page opened on startup.

dimPreviousLayers.description: Dim lower layers: In the preview, dim the layers below the current one.

dimmedLayerBrightness.description: Dimmed layer brightness: Brightness in percent of the layers dimLowerLayers darkens (0 = black, 99 = barely darkened).

filamentGroupingPopup.description: Pop up to select filament grouping mode: On multi-nozzle printers, ask for the filament grouping mode before slicing (a dialog the person answers).

leftMouseDrag.description: Left Mouse Drag: What dragging with the left mouse button does.

loadBehaviour.description: Load behaviour: Whether opening a 3MF also loads its printer, filament and process settings.

middleMouseDrag.description: Middle Mouse Drag: What dragging with the middle mouse button does.

noWarnModifiedGcode.description: Don't warn when loading 3MF with modified G-code: Open a 3MF whose custom G-code was modified without the warning dialog.

opaqueOverlays.description: Opaque overlays: Draw the 3D view's floating panels and toolbars fully opaque.

rememberPrinterConfig.description: Remember printer configuration: Remember the filament and process chosen for each printer and switch back to them with the printer.

reverseMouseZoom.description: Reverse mouse zoom: Reverse the mouse wheel's zoom direction.

rightMouseDrag.description: Right Mouse Drag: What dragging with the right mouse button does.

settingsMode.description: Settings mode: Which settings the print, filament and printer tabs show (the tabs' mode switch). Not changeable while developer mode is on.

showStepImportOptions.description: Show options when importing STEP file: Ask for the meshing options when the person imports a STEP file. Automated imports never ask: they mesh with stepLinearDeflection, stepAngleDeflection and stepSplitCompound.

stepAngleDeflection.description: STEP importing: angle deflection: Angle deflection when meshing imported STEP files; smaller is finer and slower.

stepLinearDeflection.description: STEP importing: linear deflection: Linear deflection in mm when meshing imported STEP files; smaller is finer and slower.

stepSplitCompound.description: STEP importing: Split into multiple objects: Split compound and compsolid shapes of imported STEP files into separate objects.

units.description: Units: Units shown in the interface.

useFreeCamera.description: Use free camera: A free camera instead of the constrained one.

zoomToMouse.description: Zoom to mouse position: Zoom towards the mouse pointer instead of the view centre.

actions.summary: Change cosmetic and behaviour preferences (allowlist only: units, default page, load behaviour, colour scheme, colour vision, overlays, preview dimming, camera and mouse, auto arrange, auto flush, auto slice, STEP import meshing, remember printer configuration, auto backup, two warning dialogs) and the settings mode (simple/advanced/expert). Saved at once.

actions.label: Remove mixed temperature restriction

allow.description: true lifts the check; false restores it.

actions.summary: Allow or forbid slicing plates that mix filaments with very different temperatures (the Preferences switch). Allowing asks the person in a slicer dialog first.

actions.label: Check for Updates
actions.summary: Ask the update site whether a newer version exists, as Help > Check for Updates does; the slicer shows the person the outcome.

actions.label: Cancel slicing
actions.summary: Stop the slice in progress, as the slicing notification's Cancel does: a local slice (and the rest of a Slice all), or a slicing-service (cloud) job, which the service is told to stop. Starts nothing; cancelled:false when nothing was running.

actions.label: Slicing service options
actions.summary: The slicing service's options for the selected printer, as the Slice dropdown's Slicing service options dialog shows them: each field with its type, choices, range, default, current value and whether it applies.

actions.label: Slicing service options

reset.description: Erase the remembered options first (the dialog's Reset).

toDefault.description: Back to the service's default (blank for an optional number).

actions.summary: Change the slicing service's options for the selected printer (fields by dest from slice.getOptions), or reset:true for the service's defaults, as the Slicing service options dialog's OK and Reset do. Slices nothing and sends nothing; the person's next Slice uses them.
